introduced.event_name: COMDEX November 1982 — Logix and Autodesk professional CAD presentation

products.status: Accepted COMDEX presentation and commercial offering; shipment follows hardware/software acceptance.
products.description: A jointly demonstrated professional CAD configuration combining Artemis PRO, the November professional graphics revision, Mono Pro 17, Logix Mouse and independently licensed Autodesk AutoCAD.

configuration.host: Artemis PRO, 1 MiB reference configuration, AIONix and qualified disk storage; final application minimum measured with representative drawings.
configuration.storage: Standard 5 MB disk is not promised sufficient for every CAD workload. Quote a tested storage/backup configuration; do not invent a larger shipping accessory.
configuration.professional_display: 128 KiB professional card with separate 1 KiB sprite SRAM and Ball HD17H-based analog Mono Pro 17; use dated revision effective 1982-11-29.
configuration.secondary_display: COMDEX reference station includes the existing 64 KiB card and Color Pro 14 for commands/status. Upgrade buyers may retain a compatible existing primary card/display.
configuration.software: One separately identified Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 Artemis/AIONix licence. Do not imply Logix ownership, a free licence, or later AutoCAD features.
configuration.pointing: One Logix Mouse; typed coordinates remain available for numerical precision. Explicit Autodesk mouse and dual-display integration.
configuration.output: Demonstrate a qualified pen plotter with a documented driver; plotter is optional and separately quoted. No unselected model is represented as bundled.

commercial_routes.name: Complete professional CAD configuration
commercial_routes.basis: One host, one primary display/card, one professional display/card, one mouse and one AutoCAD licence. Remove/credit replaced base-system parts in the actual quote; never charge two primary cards.

commercial_routes.name: Existing Artemis professional upgrade
commercial_routes.basis: November professional card, Mono Pro 17 and AutoCAD licence; add mouse only if needed. Verify RAM, OS, slot, storage and primary display compatibility before quoting.

products.pricing: Dated November planning prices: comdex_1982_cost_review.json. Hardware at 25% net-contribution fallback; Autodesk licence uses a provisional $1000 historical anchor. Autodesk cost/channel terms remain unknown.

support_split.logix: Hardware, AIONix integration, drivers, installation and dealer coordination.
support_split.autodesk: AutoCAD licence, application support and drawing-file compatibility.
support_split.joint: Reference configuration testing, dealer training and escalation; define response commitments before quoting service.

acceptance: Run the agreed release-quality native AutoCAD build on the reference configuration
Load/save and exchange a representative drawing; verify numerical geometry
Use both displays and the mouse with correct focus and cursor restoration
Show readable antialiased lines and stable display refresh under accelerator load
Plot a physical drawing and verify scale and geometry
Recover from interrupted work and restore a backup
Document supported features; no automatic later-version dimensioning, object-snap or 3D claims
products.timeline: June remains initial hardware availability and Autodesk development handover. November 29 is the public joint CAD offering and expanded professional-card presentation, not a rewrite of June history.

metadata.status: Engineering BOM baseline; not released for purchase or unit-cost quotation.
metadata.quantity_policy: Known quantities are integers; unresolved quantities are null and block cost roll-up. Functional assembly placeholders are not purchasable IC selections.
metadata.cost_policy: No prices invented. Separate recurring material, conversion, factory overhead, NRE/capital and commercial/service costs. Do not count an OEM subassembly and its included parts twice.

open_decisions.description: Qualify exact 16Kx1/64Kx1 suppliers, speed, rails, refresh and period volume supply, especially December 1979.
Freeze DRAM controller implementation, connector, pinout, rails, byte enables and timing; full-width does not mean zero waits.
Assign RAM/ROM/video RAM/I/O/reset address ranges without changing 24-bit physical addressing.
Baseline has no parity; optional 18-chip modules need a separately approved BOM and error path.
Select exact FDD/HDD mechanisms, interfaces, formats, OEM assembly boundaries and incoming test.
Freeze display OEM kits, receiver/DAC/analog boundaries, raster and calibration.
Aurelia family video RAM organization and count fixed: eight AION 4116-equivalent 16Kx1 DRAM chips. Qualify memory process, pinout, rails, timing, refresh and tests. Cartridge capacities remain open.

Aurelia and Aurelia+ each have three independent point-to-point ports. Qualify simultaneous keyboard/disk/printer service, port power and transceivers; freeze controller ports per die and resulting die quantity.
Qualify fixed 320/640 raster profiles and bidirectional Control identification. Freeze sync/porches, electrical levels, termination, connector and capability packet encoding.
Mono Pro console offers explicitly include keyboard/monitor; original server-only offers still require validated headless operation or a separately purchased console.
Specify die/package/process, fabrication versus outsource, yield, test and NRE for every custom chip.

Agreement and staged October 1979 sales are story commitments, not measured engineering proof. Freeze SMC process/mask compatibility, part-specific qualification dates, video RAM process margins, order codes, NRE and independent purchase quotes.
